blocks.heading: 1. Core Trigonometric Identities
blocks.intro: Pythagorean identities form the bedrock of trigonometric simplification:
bullets: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 ⇒ sin²θ = 1 - cos²θ ; cos²θ = 1 - sin²θ
sec²θ - tan²θ = 1 (θ ≠ (2n+1)π/2) ⇒ sec²θ = 1 + tan²θ ; tan²θ = sec²θ - 1
cosec²θ - cot²θ = 1 (θ ≠ nπ) ⇒ cosec²θ = 1 + cot²θ ; cot²θ = cosec²θ - 1

blocks.heading: 2. Sum & Difference Formulas
blocks.intro: Used to find values of angles like 15°, 75°, 105°, etc.:
bullets: sin(A ± B) = sin A cos B ± cos A sin B
cos(A ± B) = cos A cos B ∓ sin A sin B
tan(A ± B) = (tan A ± tan B) / (1 ∓ tan A tan B)
cot(A ± B) = (cot A cot B ∓ 1) / (cot B ± cot A)

blocks.heading: 3. Multiple Angle Identities
blocks.intro: Essential for reducing powers in calculus integrations:
bullets: sin 2A = 2 sin A cos A = 2tan A / (1 + tan² A)
cos 2A = cos² A - sin² A = 2cos² A - 1 = 1 - 2sin² A = (1 - tan² A)/(1 + tan² A)
tan 2A = 2tan A / (1 - tan² A)
sin 3A = 3sin A - 4sin³ A
cos 3A = 4cos³ A - 3cos A
tan 3A = (3tan A - tan³ A) / (1 - 3tan² A)

blocks.heading: 4. Product-to-Sum & Sum-to-Product
blocks.intro: Key transformations for calculus and equations:
bullets: 2 sin A cos B = sin(A + B) + sin(A - B)
2 cos A sin B = sin(A + B) - sin(A - B)
2 cos A cos B = cos(A + B) + cos(A - B)
2 sin A sin B = cos(A - B) - cos(A + B)
sin C + sin D = 2 sin((C+D)/2) cos((C-D)/2)
sin C - sin D = 2 cos((C+D)/2) sin((C-D)/2)
cos C + cos D = 2 cos((C+D)/2) cos((C-D)/2)
cos C - cos D = -2 sin((C+D)/2) sin((C-D)/2)
